description: How the bot should react to the mobs it meets on its first nights, for threatOf and nightThreats. Hand-written; each entry names its evidence. confidence: 'documented' = docs/research/rotn-progression.md section 2 (hazard table), which cites the RotN wiki ([W-...]); 'vanilla' = Minecraft 1.12 behaviour that the RotN sources do not mention, unverified on this pack; 'verified' = read from the mod's bytecode in the pinned pack (javap -c -p (reads class files; runs no mod code) on the jar from the pinned server pack zip (SHA-256 90642fd5...f5205); SRG names checked against MCP stable-39-1.12 fields.csv), each entry citing the jar, class and methods; 'inferred' = not checked against the mod's code (each such entry says so in its evidence). Order (first match wins): a dangerous mob (entity-overrides.json) is always 'avoid' (source 'override'); then an entry in 'entities'; then the first 'classRules' entry whose pattern matches the dumped class's simple name (source: the rule's confidence, 'inferred' unless the rule says 'verified'); then a default from the threat level (entity(): hostile = IMob or bytecode-cited player targeting): hostile -> fight, otherwise ignore (source 'default'). Class rules apply to hostile mobs only. Optional fields on an entry or class rule: 'ranged', 'explodes', and 'lookAt': false for a mob that is dangerous to look at: its targeting starts when a player looks at it (the enderman's stare check), or its gaze attack needs the player to look back (the gorgon), so the bot must not look at its head; threatOf returns lookAt true otherwise. Reactions: 'fight' (fight, ideally at a choke point; retreat when outnumbered), 'keep-distance' (back off at once, do not melee), 'take-cover' (ranged attacker: stay behind cover), 'avoid' (do not engage; move away), 'ignore-unless-provoked' (neutral until attacked or provoked), 'ignore'. Optional 'provoked' on an entry or group, for a mob that fights back once hurt (reaction 'ignore-unless-provoked'; a food animal the bot hunts, an Animania cow or hen, keeps 'ignore' so it may still be hunted, and 'provoked' says what happens once it is hit): damage (per hit, before armour), health, callsForHelp and helpers (who joins in), fightBack (false: do not fight it back early; get away), and for the Animania bulls reach, attackIntervalTicks, chaseSpeed, width, stepHeight and angerMetadata (the entity metadata index that is true while it charges). 'groups': like an entity entry, for the explicit 'members' list (any threat level), checked after 'entities' and before 'classRules'; threatOf returns the group's id as 'group'. Optional 'traits' on an entry (the troll): width, height, speed (the movement attribute), armor, knockbackResistance, immuneTo (damage types), targetsWithoutSight, breaksBlocks ('blast': see mob-digging.json 'blasters'), sunlight ('turns-to-stone'), spawnsUnderCover.

mod_lavacow:parasite.summary: A small 7-health crawler that can burst from a dead zombie, frozen zombie or mushroom zombie, or from sand dug in a dry (desert) biome. If it touches you it latches on, infests you (a slow hunger drain) and keeps biting for 1 damage, renewing the infestation with each bite, so waiting does not shake it off; unattached, it dies by itself after about 16 s. Kill it in one or two hits before it reaches you, or back away from the corpse until it dies; if one is on you, kill it.

Attaching: collideWithEntity (func_82167_n) bytecode 11-135: when a living entity that is a non-creative player (EntityPlayer.isCreative func_184812_l_ false), or a listed host, touches it and Modconfig.Parasite_Attach is set (cfg line 616 'parasite attacks by attaching onto target'=true), it gives that entity INFESTED for 160 ticks (sipush 160 at 79), rides it (startRiding func_184220_m at 91), sets long_live = true (126; the lifespan stops counting) and makes it its attack target (setAttackTarget func_70624_b at 135)
On hit: attackEntityAsMob (func_70652_k) bytecode 9-59: on a player (with Parasite_Attach) it re-applies INFESTED for 160 ticks; with skin 2 also Poison (field_76436_u) for 80 ticks (bytecode 63-87)
MobEffectInfested (performEffect func_76394_a): on a player it calls addExhaustion (func_71020_j) with 0.005f times (amplifier + 1) (bytecode 1-18): a slow hunger drain, no damage

Lifespan and release: lifespawn starts at 320 ticks (constructors, sipush 320 at 19). onLivingUpdate (func_70636_d) bytecode 1-257: it counts down unless long_live; at 0 it kills itself (attackEntityFrom with causeMobDamage(self).setDamageIsAbsolute, its max health), or, for skin 2 with a player in follow range and nextInt(100) < Modconfig.pSpawnRate_Vespa, it turns into a Vespa cocoon; the pack sets 'vespa spawn rate'=0 (cfg line 805), so on this pack it only dies. Bytecode 262-353: while riding a living entity it dismounts (dismountEntity func_110145_l, dismountRidingEntity func_184210_p) and kills itself once the host has no INFESTED, and if the host is burning (isBurning func_70027_ad) it catches fire (setFire func_70015_d 20) and drops off

Where it comes from: Fish's Undead Rising-1.3.2.jar ModEventHandler.onEDeath (LivingDeathEvent) bytecode 158-304: in a surface world (WorldProvider.isSurfaceWorld func_76569_d), a dying mob spawns parasites if it is in the host list and either nextInt(100) < Modconfig.pSpawnRate_Parasite or a parasite rides it (bytecode 167-207), or, for any mob, if it has INFESTED (211-220; so a player who dies infested leaves parasites at the corpse); the count is (3 + nextInt(3)) + (amplifier - 1) * (1 + nextInt(3)), where amplifier is INFESTED's amplifier or 0, so 0 to 4 for a mob without the effect or with Infested I. Pack config: host list lines 606-610 (minecraft:zombie, mod_lavacow:zombiefrozen, mod_lavacow:zombiemushroom; the default's husk, unburied and mummy are removed), 'parasite spawn rate'=5 (line 628). Not in any spawn list of the dump's spawns.json

iceandfire:if_troll.summary: A heavy melee hitter: 18 damage a hit (9 hearts: two hits kill an unarmoured player from full health) and Broken Armor for 10 s, 200 health, armour 9, immune to arrows, knockback-proof, and it regenerates while hurt. It is 1.2 blocks wide and 3.5 tall, faster than a zombie (speed 0.35 against 0.23), and it targets a player without needing to see them. Daylight does not make it safe: it turns to stone only when, in the daytime, it stands where it can see the sky and its light level is 13 or more; in shade (under leaves, an overhang, a roof, in a cave), in rain (daylight 12), at dawn and dusk and in thunderstorms it stays fully active and attacks by day. By day in the open it first walks to a covered spot within 10 blocks if it finds one (TrollAIFleeSun); one that turns to stone stays a statue for good. It breaks into shelters on its own (Epic Siege Mod leaves it alone): when it cannot path to its target and is 1.7 to 5.5 blocks from it, it swings at the wall and a small blast about 1.9 blocks in front of it, at its mid-height, removes the blocks the blast reaches, about one strike every 1.75 s (each strike takes 1 s, and an idle troll starts one with chance 1/15 a tick). Stone, cobblestone, planks, dirt and glass all break; a block with explosion resistance 8.37 or more (obsidian, end stone, and stone bricks, 27.5 on this pack) does not (canMobDig answers per block). Special AI also lets it break doors and gates in its way and, while idle, light sources such as torches. It spawns in 71 overworld biomes (forests, taigas, hills, mountains, snowy and some jungle and mesa biomes: monster weight 55, alone), only where it cannot see the sky (caves, under trees or overhangs) and, as any monster, in the dark. Do not fight it on the first night and do not trust a cobblestone shelter when one is near: keep more than 5.5 blocks of solid ground between you and it, or a troll-proof wall, and do not count on daylight under trees.

Melee: attackEntityAsMob (func_70652_k) only starts ANIMATION_STRIKE_VERTICAL or _HORIZONTAL (20 ticks each, static init); onLivingUpdate (func_70636_d) offsets 654-729 and 730-804: at animation tick 10, if getDistanceSq(target) < 4.0 (2 blocks, feet to feet), target.attackEntityFrom(causeMobDamage(troll), ATTACK_DAMAGE); the horizontal strike also throws the target up (motionY 0.4, offsets 915-941)

BlockBreakExplosion (vanilla Explosion's ray rule, troll.javap.txt '## BlockBreakExplosion'): each ray starts with power size x (0.7 + 0.6 x nextFloat), so below 2.6; a block is affected while power - (resistance + 0.3) x 0.3 stays above 0 (resistance from the exploder's getExplosionResistance, the block's), and power drops 0.225 per 0.3-block step: so a block with resistance 8.37 or more is never broken (2.6 / 0.3 - 0.3); doExplosionB drops the affected blocks (dropBlockAsItemWithChance) and removes them (onBlockExploded). Entities within 2 x size take causeMobDamage(troll) for ((v^2 + v) / 2 x 7 x 2size + 1) / 6, at most 4.8, where v = (1 - distance/2size) x exposure

Epic Siege Mod leaves it alone: config/esm/epicsiegemod.cfg:579 lists iceandfire:if_troll in S:"AI Blacklist" (line 5, 'Mobs that are exempt from AI modifications'), and config/esm/entity_ai.json has no entry for it (EpicSiegeMod-13.169.jar (in the pack as mods/EpicSiegeMod-13.169.jar, SHA-256 398b7558dce5bf903df4afc6c143347d3245959f19c98d23f2f0312fb0a9c127))

Sunlight: onLivingUpdate offsets 202-383: setAvoidSun(world.isDaytime()); on the server, by day, when getBrightness() > 0.5 and world.canSeeSky(its block) it sets StoneEntityProperties.isStone and stops; ServerEvents.onEntityUpdate (offsets 1811-2076) then zeroes a stone mob's motion, sets NoAI and clears its target every tick, and onEntityDespawn denies its despawn; nothing in the jar sets isStone back to false (only ItemStoneStatue, ItemGorgonHead, EntityGorgon and EntityTroll set it, to true). config/ice_and_fire.cfg:222 'Entities immune to being turned to stone' does not list it

Also: attackEntityFrom (func_70097_a) ignores any damage type containing 'arrow'; below max health it gets Regeneration II for 30 ticks every 30 ticks (offsets 155-197); getCanSpawnHere (func_70601_bi): nextInt(trollSpawnCheckChance = 1) == 0 and not canSeeSky(the block above it), then EntityMob's (vanilla: a light-level check, not read)

Daylight in shade: TrollAIFleeSun.shouldExecute runs only while world.isDaytime() and canSeeSky(its feet) and findPossibleShelter() finds, in 10 random tries within 10 blocks across and 3 up or down, a block that cannot see the sky (and getBlockPathWeight < 0); it has mutex 1, so it takes over from EntityAIAttackMelee (priority 3) only while it runs. Under cover nothing in the troll stops it by day. Brightness above 0.5 means light 13 or more, and isDaytime means skylightSubtracted below 4 (vanilla WorldProvider brightness table and World.calculateSkylightSubtracted: rain takes 3 off the sky light, a thunderstorm 5; not read)

Spawns: the dump's spawn lists (spawns.json, 'monster') have iceandfire:if_troll in 71 overworld biomes with weight 55, groups of 1; config/ice_and_fire.cfg:459 B:"Spawn Trolls"=true, :501 I:"Troll Spawn Weight"=55; config/incontrol/spawn.json and potentialspawn.json name it only for dimension 10 (1% at light 7 or less, else deny): no In Control rule touches it in the overworld

EntityAIAttackMeleeBulls is built with longMemory false, so it stops when its path ends and starts again while the target is kept

groups.summary: An Animania cow fights back: a hit makes it, and every other cow of the same breed nearby, chase the attacker and hit for 2 damage once a second (18 health each). The hit counts as a bull's ("gored to death"). One cow is a safe kill with a weapon; a herd turning on the bot is not. Hunt a cow only with no other cow of its breed within 16 blocks and no bull near (one cow in three spawns with a bull on the same spot), finish it quickly, and back off if a second one comes. The reaction stays 'ignore' because cows are food: the bot may start the fight.
